items.hed: Alperen Sengun scored 43 points and grabbed 12 rebounds as the Rockets held off Utah 125-118 Friday night, handing the Jazz their 11th straight loss
items.insight: Houston improved to 9-3 with the NBA Cup group-play win over Utah at Toyota Center, leaning on Sengun's career-high scoring night alongside Fred VanVleet and Amen Thompson in the rotation, per the league's official game page. The Jazz have now lost 11 in a row and remain well under .500 on the season.

items.hed: The Texans enter Sunday's game at Tennessee with Marvin Harrison Jr., Danielle Hunter and Azeez Al-Shaair all officially out, while Will Anderson Jr. and two offensive linemen are questionable
items.insight: Houston's final Week 11 injury report lists Harrison (hamstring), Hunter (hamstring) and Al-Shaair (groin) as out after none practiced Friday, while Anderson (ankle), tackle Trent Brown (illness/wrist) and guard Wyatt Teller (back/illness) are questionable, the team's official injury report shows. Tight end Brevin Jordan and center/guard Keylan Rutledge are also out.

items.hed: Yordan Alvarez was named to the 2026 All-MLB First Team, adding a second honor this week after his unanimous AL MVP award
items.insight: MLB.com confirmed Alvarez's selection to the 2026 All-MLB First Team, which recognizes the top player at each position across both leagues, days after the Baseball Writers' Association named him the American League's unanimous MVP.
